text:
- [IRET.1.7] **Alpha dispatch by schema index.** Every
  schema is assigned a compact integer ID at load time.
  The alpha dispatch table is a flat array indexed by
  schema ID; each entry is the list of alpha nodes
  registered for that schema. Dispatch on a new/retracted
  fact is O(1) index + O(alpha_count_for_schema)
  iteration; no linear scan of all patterns.

idris.name: iret_1_7__indices
idris.note: The alpha nodes in dispatch order: by position, the flat array's iteration.

idris.name: iret_6_4__dispatch_assert
idris.note: Dispatch visits the alpha nodes in position order.

idris.name: iret_1_7__dispatch_start
idris.note: Before a dispatch: every alpha in the list shows the old working memory; an index beyond the list is the dangling node, which shows nothing under any working memory.

idris.name: iret_1_7__indices_all
idris.note: Every index in range is in the dispatch list.

idris.name: iret_1_7__indices_distinct
idris.note: The dispatch list visits each alpha once.

idris.name: iret_1_7__indices_lt
idris.note: Every index in the dispatch list is in range.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_frame
idris.note: Dispatch by schema index on retract, likewise.

idris.name: iret_6_4__dispatch_assert_frame
idris.note: Dispatch by schema index on assert reaches the alphas registered for the fact's schema; a chain with no node on them is left.

idris.name: iret_1_7__nth_some
idris.note: An index into one of two lists of one length is an index into the other.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_pairs
idris.note: Alpha dispatch on retract, as `iret_19_2__dispatch_retract` runs it.

idris.name: iret_6_4__dispatch_assert_pairs
idris.note: Alpha dispatch on assert, as `iret_6_4__dispatch_assert` runs it: per admitting alpha, every chain.
